notes.title: Bagdex Demo Update - v0.0.2 🛠️
notes.content:
Hey there, trainers!

Your duels in PvP Battle Mode just got another upgrade! 🔥

Remember that friend you smacked down and who got their revenge? Well, it’s time to strike back again — with more Bagmons and a brand-new stage! 😎

[h2]What’s New ✨[/h2]
[list]
[*]New [b]Find Match[/b] feature: it's now easier than ever to find Trainers to battle!
[*]New Bagmons now available in PvP Mode:
[list]
[*]Meanmic
[*]Blondmarie
[*]Clayzzard
[*]Coffantom
[*]Armadrop
[/list][*]New random PvP battle stage: Grass Lands
[/list]

We can’t wait to see you all exploring new moves, stages, and Bagmons! As always, stay tuned — more surprises are coming! 👀

👉 Don’t forget to [b]add Bagdex to your wishlist[/b] and follow us on social media to stay up to date with all the latest news.

See you in Brasilis!

notes.title: 🌟 Bagdex at OTK Games Expo 2025 – Let’s Showcase the Strength of Brazilian Game
notes.content:
[h3]It is with immense joy that we announce Bagdex's participation in the OTK Games Expo 2025, one of the largest international events dedicated to independent games! We are honored to represent Brazil on this global stage and we want to count on your support to showcase the strength of Brazilian games to the world.[/h3]

[h3][b]🗓️ Save the Date: May 25, 2025[/b][/h3]

The live broadcast will be available on the following channels:

[list][*]  [url=Twitch.tv/OTKnetwork]Twitch.tv/OTKnetwork[/url]
[*]  [url=YouTube.com/@OTKGamesExpo]YouTube.com/@OTKGamesExpo[/url] [/list]

[b][h3]🗳️[b] How to Vote for Bagdex[/b][/h3][/b]
During the event, you can vote for Bagdex through the following platforms:

Twitch Voting Extension: While watching the broadcast on Twitch, use the voting extension that will appear on the screen.

[b]Official OTK Games Expo Website: The link will be released on May 25.[/b]

[b][h3][b]🎁 Exclusive Benefits for the Community[/b][/h3][/b]
To thank you for your support, we will be distributing exclusive prizes to members of our Discord server. If you're not part of it yet, join us and stay updated with all the news:

👉 [url=https://discord.gg/c6QwdxfjeP]Our Server[/url]

[b][h3][b]🇧🇷 National Pride[/b][/h3][/b]
Participating in the OTK Games Expo is a unique opportunity to show the world the talent and creativity of Brazilian developers. With your vote, we can highlight Bagdex and strengthen Brazil's presence in the global gaming industry.

[b][h3][b]📢 We Count on You![/b][/h3][/b]
On May 25, join us for the live broadcast, vote for Bagdex, and share this news with your friends and family. Together, we can reach new heights and show that Brazil is a powerhouse in independent game development!

notes.title: Bagdex Demo Update - v0.0.1.7 🛠️
notes.content:
Hey there, trainers!

Your duels in PvP Battle Mode just got better in the Bagdex Demo! 🔥

Take this chance to call that friend who beat you up and get your payback right now, with [b]more Bagmons[/b] and a [b]new scenario![/b] 😎

[h2]What's New ✨[/h2]
[list]
[*] New Bagmons available in PvP mode:
[list]
[*] Jingleboom
[*] Frituff
[*] Calphin
[*] Doldandy
[*] Pogwan
[*] Ratbath[/list][*] New random scenario for PvP Battle: Essential Cave
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes and Improvements 🐛[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that crashed the game when trying to play Battle Demo for the 2nd time
[*] Now, it's possible to skip [spoiler]Bojarro's advertisement[/spoiler] in the Battle Demo
[*] Fixed a bug that froze the game when finishing battle by dying from Duraiba's passive
[*] Fixed an issue with Bagmons' outline being incorrectly cut
[*] Fixed a bug where multiple players could try to enter the same room using the same code
[*] Revision of UI scaling sizes
[/list]


We're excited to see all of you exploring these new features! And stay tuned, as we'll always have more surprises! 👀

👉 Don't forget to [b]add Bagdex to your wishlist[/b] and follow our social media to stay updated with all new developments.


See you in Brasilis!
